rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Walked all 6 body bullets against the three low-value classes (doctrine restatement / self-referential design commentary / aphorism kicker). Chunk1's bullet (line 21) names the transcript-file mechanism that grounds the ask below it — a mechanism, not restated doctrine (the maintainer's dated Lean-intro-trim note, raw line 89, records that the one bullet closer to doctrine-restatement/self-referential-design-commentary territory was already cut this training-architecture pass). Chunk2's two bullets (29-30) are a WIP-scoping warning and the task.md artefact-contract mechanism, distinct from chunk0's 'What you build' line. Chunk3's bullet (38) gives the reasoning for the optional push (a priority: local-by-default, throwaway, forkable). Chunk5's three bullets (54-56): a laptop-awake move, the ten-or-so nudge calibration + 'read the transcript' (a concrete tell, covered under rule 7's accept-note), and the stop-if-off-the-rails policy (a priority distinct from chunk0's 'The point' line) — plus the closing line 'If Claude stalls... The nudge reads as encouragement and lands as a taunt', which is load-bearing setup for the deliberately taunting prompt immediately below it, not a decorative kicker. Closest call: chunk5 line 56 'The trace is the evidence either way' echoes the module's own arc-level 'Traces are data' framing (`run-the-first-experiment.md` line 50) but applies that principle to authorize stopping THIS specific session at THIS specific moment — an actionable permission, not a redundant recitation. No aphorism kicker or self-referential design commentary found anywhere in the current body.
